items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: So we had Rick Carr, you know what I mean? Yeah, he was on that record, Maya Josephine, Rick Carr and Celestan.

ctx.x: Yeah, I mean, you know on the Silestan records there's always two trumpet players.

Why did they have that? We started that in 1926 when we were recording, my number, Maya Josephine. That was 1926, they started using two trumpets. So we had Rick Carr, you know what I mean? Yeah, he was on that record, Maya Josephine, Rick Carr and Celestan. But after that the band started, they introduced the big bands. And that was around around 1926, 1927. After that's when I left Celestan and went with King Oliver and had me start using the real big bands.
Who else was in that saxophone section in the Celestan band? Do you remember who else was in the band?
